title: channel.py: OverflowError if seed is negative or exceeds 32 bits
description: Line 81: `seed.to_bytes(4, 'little')` raises OverflowError for negative seed or seed > 0xFFFFFFFF. Unlike sfn which is masked with `& 0xFFFFFFFF`, seed has no protection. GnssHopConfig.seed is typed as int with no bounds. Inconsistent with sfn handling on same line.
close_reason: seed.to_bytes now masks with & 0xFFFFFFFF (same u32 wrap as sfn). Tests: test_seed_wraps_as_u32 against independent FNV-1a oracle. pytest tests/link/test_channel.py 33 passed.
